title: Learning rate warmup with extended peak period
description: Add 5% warmup, reduce warmdown to 25%, set final LR fraction to 0.01
reflection: LR schedule changes made val_bpb worse (0.998767 vs 0.996598 baseline). The original zero-warmup, 50% warmdown schedule was actually better tuned. This suggests either: (1) the baseline schedule is near-optimal for the model, or (2) the proposed schedule changes introduced instability. Future rounds should explore other directions like model scaling rather than schedule tweaking.
